subject: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@acme.com>, Mike Lopez <mike.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan — Acme Corp

Hi Jordan / Mike,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to learn more about Acme's search & recommendation use case and the latency/cost targets you're aiming for. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation to validate latency (p95 < 350ms on 512-token prompts) and quality on your prompt set.
- Success criteria: equal-or-better relevance on the top-5 reranks vs current model across our shared eval set; cost target ~30% below current per-token spend.
- Scope: Redwood hosted evaluation with a dedicated model variant, prefix caching enabled, and a prompt/eval harness to automate scoring.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (30–45m). We suggest a short trial plan walkthrough + technical deep-dive to align on prompt set, access, and success criteria. I'm available:

- Wed 9/16: 10:00–11:30 PT or 15:00–17:00 PT
- Thu 9/17: 09:00–12:00 PT

Connor (cc'd) will lead the technical deep-dive and own the trial setup. I've attached a one-page evaluation_plan.pdf with a draft timeline and a trial_scope.xlsx (sample prompts / data requirements).

Please let me know which slot works or share a Calendly/availability and we'll lock it in.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evaluation_plan.pdf (PDF, 120KB); trial_scope.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the doc. This aligns with what we discussed.

We'd like to include our infra lead (Mike) on the kickoff so he can validate networking and data access requirements. For timing, Thu 9/17 09:30–10:15 PT works on our side. If you can do 09:30 that would be great.

A couple quick clarifications before the kick-off: 
- We'll need a short list of required IAM roles and any IP allowlist ranges you expect for the hosted evaluation.
- For the prompt set: we'll share a redacted dump of 500 sample prompts ahead of time — is that sufficient for an initial eval?

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Jordan

Perfect — Thu 9/17 09:30 PT is locked. I'll send a calendar invite in a separate email.

Jordan: to answer your infra questions ahead of time:
- IAM / access: we only need a service account with scoped read access to the S3 bucket (or a secure upload link) for the prompt/eval set. We'll provide a minimal IAM policy and a sample presigned upload flow.
- IP allowlist: for hosted evaluations we'll provide the IP ranges for our US cluster; Connor will paste the ranges & egress notes in the kickoff.

Connor — can you take the technical deep-dive and confirm the list of required IPs / roles live on the call? Also, can you bring a short checklist for data redaction guidance and prompt ingestion?

Jordan / Mike — please share the redacted prompt dump (S3 link or .csv) before EOD 9/16 so we can pre-run the eval harness.

Thanks,
—Marissa

(Calendar invite to follow)
